title: Coding Set 04: Single-Pass Scans & String Manipulation
description: Reported HCL coding tasks: second largest distinct element in O(N) and reversing word order with whitespace normalization.

problems.title: Second Largest Distinct Element
problems.statement: Given an array of N integers (possibly containing duplicates and negative values), find the second largest DISTINCT element in a single O(N) pass without sorting. If no second distinct element exists (e.g., all elements are equal or N < 2), print 'NONE'.
problems.inputFormat:
Line 1: Integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: Print the second largest distinct integer, or 'NONE'.
constraints: O(N) time and O(1) extra space

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
n = data[0]
arr = data[1:1+n]
# Write your solution here

edgeCases: All negative numbers (avoid sentinel 0 or Integer.MIN_VALUE collision)
Duplicates of the maximum element ('2 1 2 2' -> 1, not 2)

problems.title: Reverse Words & Normalize Whitespace
problems.statement: Given a sentence string S that may contain leading spaces, trailing spaces, and multiple consecutive spaces between words, reverse the order of the words and join them with a single space.
problems.inputFormat: A single line containing string S.
problems.outputFormat: The words in reverse order separated by single spaces.
constraints: S contains at least one non-space character

starterCode.python:
import sys

problems.timeComplexity: O(N) scanning and building the reversed output.
problems.spaceComplexity: O(N) for word tokens / output buffer.
edgeCases: Multiple spaces and tabs between words
